search_button.what: Runs the block search with the text in the search field.
examples: Type "hand" and click it to find every hand block.
Clear the search to see every block again.
Search "skin" to find Load Skin and the other skin blocks.
search_button.details: Restarts a debounce timer; the search runs when it fires. Right click it for Reload All Blocks / Update All Blocks.

prebuild.tip: Edit the pre-build code of the selected block.
prebuild.what: Opens the code that runs right before this block builds. For riggers.
examples: Unlock a joint chain or rename a node before the block uses it.
Delete a leftover node from an old build before the block runs.
prebuild.details: Edits the string attr <Block>_Config.precode, run right before that block builds. It is saved in the scene, not in the block file.

current_code.tip: View the build code of the selected block.
current_code.what: Shows the Python code this block runs when it builds. Read only.
examples: Check what a block does before changing its options.
Copy a line from the block code to use it in a postbuild.
current_code.details: Finds the exec_*.py from the block Import_Command (legacy names map to _v001) under Blocks/ and opens it read only.

postbuild.tip: Edit the post-build code of the selected block.
postbuild.what: Opens the code that runs right after this block builds. For riggers.
examples: Add an extra constraint or set a default value once the block is built.
Lock and hide an attr animators should not touch.
postbuild.details: Edits <Block>_Config.postcode, run right after that block builds. Find nodes by name: they are rebuilt every time.

reload_ui.what: Clears the search and the properties panel and redraws all the blocks of the scene.
examples: Click it after adding blocks by script so they show up.
Reload after undoing a block delete.
reload_ui.details: Clears the search and the properties panel, then create_layout() reads Mutant_Build again.

log.what: Opens the log of the last build: every block, the time it took and any error.
examples: After a failed build, open it to see which block broke and why.
Send it with a bug report.
Check how long each block took to find the slow one.
log.details: Reads Mutant_log.txt from the Maya user script folder (cmds.internalVar(usd=True)).

build_btn.what: Builds every block under Mutant_Build (or the selected block / group, from the menu next to it). If a rig is already built it asks to rebuild, saving and loading back skins and controller shapes.
steps: Pick the build mode in the menu next to it.
Read the IO report if one shows up.
examples: Place the guides, click Build, wait for the bar to finish.
Choose "Build Selected Block" in the menu to test only one block.
Rebuild after moving guides: skins and ctrl shapes come back.
Build Selected Group to test one part of the rig.
build_btn.details: build_autorigger(): one undo chunk. Delete and Rebuild saves skins (IOSkin pack or EasySkin json) and ctrl shapes to temp, deletes Mutant_Tools_Grp, runs RunBeforeBuild blocks, builds each block (precode, Build_Command, postcode), then loads skins and ctrls back. If a block fails the build stops there and skins are NOT loaded back, so reopen the file instead of rebuilding again from that state.
